entities.summary: Nipaporn Boonyaliang(born Nipaporn Paeng-Ouan; August 25, 1987), better known by the stage name Kratae R-Siam, is a Thai luk thung singer under the R-Siam label. She also has a background in Muay Thai and adheres to Buddhism.
